primary_question: Does the complete history/track/auxiliary package improve over native single-frame ACT? This pair does not isolate auxiliary or motion contributions.

auxiliary.semantics: observation-only expert continuation; not action-conditioned dynamics

data.point_sampling: frozen current-visible FPS64 plus seed/tick permutation, disjoint K/Q
data.history_source: oracle persistent vertices including occluded history
data.test_episodes_20_24: untouched; not used in preparation or model selection
data.validation_scope: reused development validation; not a fresh test

selection: lowest full-validation prior-zero denormalized action chunk MSE at fixed common checkpoints; ties keep earliest; retain final checkpoint too

closed_loop.initialization: pre-play garment authoring; fixed total60 physics ticks; canonical per-stage/pose, authored by ACT seed1000 before actor; <=5 initial-state-only retries; no runtime/outcome retries

interpretation: Auxiliary predictions regularize shared observations during training; policy inference uses only the unchanged ACT action path. Compute cost differs and must be reported. A Tracks-only ablation is required before claiming auxiliary causation.

resources.submission_status: not_submitted; user must review concrete plan before training
resources.strategy: six independent single-GPU runs, expensive Tracks runs first; reuse all freed cards plus two reserved slots for registered paired evaluations; matched batch/steps, no DDP
resources.telemetry: allocated-GPU utilization/memory/power every30s; owned process timings and per-run validation/elapsed metrics
